name: Galiza
source:
Galiza is a wizard and at the same time a witch, often leading you astray with his puzzling actions and speech. He is the one who led you to the fairytale world and the only person who knows the full truth behind it.

"C'mon, don't worry about stuff so much! I'll always be here to listen to your troubles for you after all!"
